answer: Deposits are visible in vault, and sable reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 19% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 95 aliases, and each one needs its own funded raven account. A farm of 3883 identities would post 4512 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
